item.title: e-Rum 2020 Slides on Progressr
item.description: I presented Progressr: An Inclusive, Unifying API for Progress Updates (15 minutes; 20 slides) at e-Rum 2020, on June 17, 2020: Abstract HTML (incremental Google Slides; requires online access) PDF (flat slides) Video (starts at 00h49m58s) I am grateful for everyone involved who made e-Rum 2020 possible. I cannot imagine having to cancel the on-site Milano conference that had planned for more than a year and then start over to re-organize and create a fabulous online experience for ~1,500 participants in such short notice.
